summary: Gifford Pinchot NF highpoint: a 1920s cabin, then an 11x11 ft L-shaped cabin built in 1929 and in use in 1953; removed or destroyed in the 1940s or 1960s. No summit views.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: WillhiteWeb dates the cabin's destruction to the 1940s; the register and firelookout.com say removed or destroyed in the 1960s. A 1953 newspaper report describes a tiny cabin at the site that year, so if it is the same cabin, the 1940s date cannot be right. The 1960s dates are not contradicted by any source read, but no source gives an exact year.
The first lookout was a cabin from the 1920s, and the L-shaped cabin with cupola was built in 1929. Both are in the sources; the first cabin's year is not given.

notes_for_editor: The shared WebSearch budget ran out before this tower's search, so the story rests only on the four cached pages listed. The fate date is disputed and no exact year is given by any source; no removal event is recorded for that reason. The 1929 and 1953 facts come from newspaper excerpts quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; the originals were not checked. The 1953 staffing is recorded as a single newspaper report, not a season of service. Road conditions for the Forest Service roads were not checked. No photos added: licences not checked.
